# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: postgres
description: Postgres Helm chart for non-production
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "15"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: postgres
  tag: "15"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
persistence:
  enabled: true
  storageClassName: ""
  size: 10Gi
auth:
  postgresPassword: "changeit"
  username: "appuser"
  password: "changeit"
  database: "appdb"
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 256Mi
  limits:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 512Mi
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  postgres-password: {{ .Values.auth.postgresPassword | quote }}
  username: {{ .Values.auth.username | quote }}
  password: {{ .Values.auth.password | quote }}
  database: {{ .Values.auth.database | quote }}
---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.service.type }}
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
  ports:
    - port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
      protocol: TCP
      name: postgres
---
# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
                  key: postgres-password
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
                  key: username
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
                  key: database
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
              name: postgres
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources | nindent 12 }}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.persistence.storageClassName | quote }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.persistence.size }}
---
# FILE: templates/init-job.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-init
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
        - name: init-db
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          env:
            - name: PGPASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
                  key: postgres-password
            - name: PGUSER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
                  key: username
            - name: PGDATABASE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
                  key: database
          command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              until pg_isready -h {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }} -p 5432; do sleep 2; done
              psql -h {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }} -c "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ${PGDATABASE};" || true
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "postgres.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "postgres.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride -}}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- else -}}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
